**How to falsify it:** The identification of pathogenic variants in MMP13 with a gain-of-function mechanism for either disease, or the identification of completely distinct causal pathways for each disease that do not converge on extracellular matrix remodeling. _(variant: Exclusion of pathogenic variants in MMP13 from gnomAD populations if they are found at a high frequency (>1%) would support the rarity and pathogenicity of the variants.)_
